"""Dry by default; publish one exact certificate descendant to two fork refs.

No builds, source changes, upstream/main writes, evidence-folder edits or retry.
Root supplies the reviewed commit and immutable closure hashes after exact gates.
"""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
import subprocess

REPO=Path('/private/tmp/sail-certificate-parent-witness')
EVIDENCE=Path('/Users/alexy/src/grust/docs/reviews/sail-stream-experiments-2026-09-30/certificate-parent-witness')
OUTPUT=EVIDENCE.parent/'certificate-parent-witness-delivery.json'
BASE='fc094a0c25a49edeac2f9f0195aa973421a21a43'
TREE='cd73d093230153857de196abc17ea8e98464149b'
REMOTE='git@github.com:querygraph/sail.git'
BRANCH='refs/heads/work/certificate-parent-witness'
COMBINED='refs/heads/work/stream-review-followup'
ENV=dict(os.environ,GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0')


def now():return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def check(value,message):
    if not value:raise RuntimeError(message)
def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:return hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
def load(path):return json.loads(path.read_text())
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(REPO),*args],env=ENV,timeout=120)
def text(*args):return git(*args).decode().strip()
def child(root,name):
    p=PurePosixPath(name)
    check(not p.is_absolute() and p.parts and '..' not in p.parts and str(p)==name,'unsafe path')
    return root/p


def refs():
    for flags in (('--all',),('--push','--all')):
        check(text('remote','get-url',*flags,'querygraph')==REMOTE,'fork destination differs')
    rows=text('ls-remote','--heads','querygraph',BRANCH,COMBINED).splitlines()
    result={r.split()[1]:r.split()[0] for r in rows}
    check(len(rows)==len(result),'duplicate refs')
    return result


def inventory(manifest,commit):
    check(manifest['commit']==commit and manifest['file_count']==len(manifest['files']),'manifest scope differs')
    expected=manifest['files']
    actual=set()
    for p in EVIDENCE.rglob('*'):
        check(not p.is_symlink(),'evidence symlink')
        if p.is_file():actual.add(str(p.relative_to(EVIDENCE)))
    check(actual==set(expected)|{'files-manifest.json'},'evidence inventory differs')
    for name,digest in expected.items():check(sha(child(EVIDENCE,name))==digest,'evidence changed: '+name)


def source_guard(commit,source,frozen):
    check(text('symbolic-ref','HEAD')==BRANCH,'branch differs')
    check(text('rev-parse','HEAD')==commit and text('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')==TREE,'source identity differs')
    check(text('write-tree')==TREE and not text('status','--porcelain'),'source not clean')
    entries={}
    for entry in git('ls-files','--stage','-z').split(b'\0'):
        if not entry:continue
        meta,name=entry.split(b'\t',1);mode,blob,stage=meta.decode().split()
        check(stage=='0','unmerged index');entries[os.fsdecode(name)]=(mode,blob)
    check(set(entries)==set(source['files']),'tracked inventory differs')
    for name,(mode,blob) in entries.items():
        p=child(REPO,name);expected=source['files'][name]
        check((mode,blob)==(expected['mode'],expected['blob']),'logical index differs: '+name)
        raw=os.fsencode(os.readlink(p)) if p.is_symlink() else p.read_bytes()
        check(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==expected['working_sha256'] and len(raw)==expected['bytes'],
              'working source differs: '+name)
        check(p.is_symlink()==(mode=='120000'),'source kind differs')
        if not p.is_symlink():check(bool(p.stat().st_mode & 0o111)==(mode=='100755'),'source mode differs')
    for name,digest in frozen['source_hashes'].items():check(sha(child(REPO,name))==digest,'changed source differs')
    check(text('rev-parse','HEAD')==commit and text('write-tree')==TREE,'source moved')


def gate_guard(kind,head,mode):
    root=EVIDENCE/kind;gate=load(root/'receipt.json')
    check(gate['outcome']=='PASS' and gate['head']==head and gate['tree']==TREE and gate['mode']==mode,'wrong gate')
    check(gate['source_runtime_unchanged'] is True and gate['server_reaped'] is True,'unclosed or changed gate')
    check(gate['unit_counts']==dict(tests=473,failures=0,errors=0,skipped=136),'unit inventory differs')
    check(gate['sql_counts']==dict(tests=71,failures=0,errors=0,skipped=0),'server-configured inventory differs')
    check(len(gate['commands'])==8 and all(row['returncode']==0 for row in gate['commands']),'gate commands differ')
    check(gate['sql_isolation']=='one fresh pytest subprocess per test module','client isolation differs')
    check([row['counts']['tests'] for row in gate['sql_modules']]==[9,43,6,6,7],'module inventories differ')
    for name,digest in gate['logs'].items():check(sha(child(root,name))==digest,'gate log differs')
    before=load(root/'source-before.json')
    check(before==load(root/'source-after.json'),'full source snapshots differ')
    check(before['head']==head and before['tree']==TREE and before['mode']==mode,'wrong source snapshot')
    for name,digest in gate['runtime_and_helper_pins'].items():check(sha(Path(name))==digest,'gate runtime/helper changed')
    check((root/'client-before.log').read_bytes()==(root/'client-after.log').read_bytes(),'client identity changed')
    return gate,before


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ('commit','final-sha256','audit-sha256','manifest-sha256','script-sha256'):
        p.add_argument('--'+name,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--execute',action='store_true');a=p.parse_args()
    check(len(a.commit)==40 and all(x in '0123456789abcdef' for x in a.commit),'invalid commit')
    check(sha(Path(__file__))==a.script_sha256,'delivery helper differs')
    check(not OUTPUT.exists() and not OUTPUT.is_symlink(),'delivery already attempted')
    check(sha(EVIDENCE/'final-receipt.json')==a.final_sha256 and sha(EVIDENCE/'files-manifest.json')==a.manifest_sha256,'closure differs')
    final=load(EVIDENCE/'final-receipt.json');manifest=load(EVIDENCE/'files-manifest.json')
    check(final['outcome']=='EXACT_COMPONENT_GATE_PASS' and final['commit']==a.commit and final['base']==BASE
          and final['tree']==TREE and final['branch']==BRANCH.removeprefix('refs/heads/'),'wrong component closure')
    check(final['delivery']=='NOT_PUSHED_AT_EVIDENCE_CUTOFF','wrong delivery cutoff')
    check(final['server_configured_cases']==71 and final['actual_sql_cases']==67 and final['pure_argument_cases']==4,'scope differs')
    for name,digest in final['inputs'].items():check(sha(child(EVIDENCE,name))==digest,'closed input differs')
    audit_path=EVIDENCE/'independent-exact-review.json'
    check(sha(audit_path)==a.audit_sha256==final['inputs']['independent-exact-review.json'],'audit pin differs')
    audit=load(audit_path);frozen=load(EVIDENCE/'frozen.json')
    check(audit['outcome']=='PASS_INDEPENDENT_PARENT_WITNESS_EXACT_AUDIT' and audit['commit']==a.commit
          and audit['tree']==TREE and not audit['blockers'],'wrong independent audit')
    check(frozen['base']==BASE and frozen['tree']==TREE and len(frozen['source_hashes'])==4
          and audit['source_hashes']==frozen['source_hashes'],'source pins differ')
    check(audit['readme_sha256']==sha(EVIDENCE/'README.md'),'reviewed prose differs')
    inventory(manifest,a.commit)
    candidate,_=gate_guard('candidate-gate02',BASE,'candidate')
    exact,source=gate_guard('exact-gate02',a.commit,'exact')
    check(candidate['runtime_and_helper_pins']==exact['runtime_and_helper_pins'],'gate runtime differs')
    source_guard(a.commit,source,frozen)
    check(text('rev-parse',a.commit+'^')==BASE,'not expected direct child')
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(REPO),'merge-base','--is-ancestor',BASE,a.commit],env=ENV,check=True)
    before=refs();check(before=={COMBINED:BASE},'refs changed or component already exists')
    command=['git','-C',str(REPO),'push','--atomic','--force-with-lease='+BRANCH+':',
             '--force-with-lease='+COMBINED+':'+BASE,'querygraph',a.commit+':'+BRANCH,a.commit+':'+COMBINED]
    if not a.execute:
        print(json.dumps(dict(outcome='VALIDATED_NOT_PUSHED',utc=now(),commit=a.commit,tree=TREE,
            remote_before=before,command=command,script_sha256=a.script_sha256),indent=2));return
    report=dict(started_utc=now(),outcome='PUSH_NOT_YET_COMPLETED',repository='querygraph/sail',commit=a.commit,
        base=BASE,tree=TREE,branches=[BRANCH,COMBINED],remote_before=before,command=command,
        final_receipt_sha256=a.final_sha256,independent_audit_sha256=a.audit_sha256,manifest_sha256=a.manifest_sha256,
        delivery_script_sha256=a.script_sha256,delivery_script_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),
        last_completed_phase='all_preconditions_passed',scope=final['scope'])
    with OUTPUT.open('x') as stream:json.dump(report,stream,indent=2);stream.write('\n');stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    try:
        source_guard(a.commit,source,frozen);inventory(manifest,a.commit)
        check(sha(Path(__file__))==a.script_sha256,'helper changed before push')
        result=subprocess.run(command,env=ENV,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
        report.update(push_returncode=result.returncode,push_stdout=result.stdout,push_stderr=result.stderr)
        check(result.returncode==0,'push failed; no automatic retry')
        report['last_completed_phase']='atomic_push_returned_zero';report['remote_after']=refs()
        check(report['remote_after']=={BRANCH:a.commit,COMBINED:a.commit},'remote verification differs')
        source_guard(a.commit,source,frozen);inventory(manifest,a.commit)
        report.update(outcome='PUSHED_AND_REMOTELY_VERIFIED',last_completed_phase='both_refs_and_source_verified')
    except BaseException as error:
        report.update(outcome='DELIVERY_INCOMPLETE_NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY',error=repr(error))
        if isinstance(error,subprocess.TimeoutExpired):report['push_outcome_uncertain']=True
        raise
    finally:
        report['finished_utc']=now();temporary=OUTPUT.with_suffix('.tmp')
        with temporary.open('x') as stream:json.dump(report,stream,indent=2);stream.write('\n');stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary.replace(OUTPUT)
    print(json.dumps(dict(outcome=report['outcome'],commit=a.commit,remote_after=report['remote_after'])))


if __name__=='__main__':main()
